title: Final Answer for Part (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state that the total kinetic energy equals the total internal energy when gamma equals 5/3.

title: Final Answer for Part (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state that gamma must be greater than 4/3 for gravitational equilibrium.

title: Application of Virial Theorem
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the virial theorem to relate kinetic and potential energy.

title: Use of Ideal Gas Relations
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly use the relationship between internal energy density and kinetic energy density for an ideal gas.

title: Correct Derivation Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student should show clear derivation steps leading to the final results for both parts.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes when applying the virial theorem and relating energies.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Understanding of Gamma
description: Optional Criteria: The student may provide a clear explanation of the significance of gamma in the context of the problem.

title: Limiting Cases Discussion
description: Optional Criteria: The student could discuss limiting cases or implications of the results for different values of gamma.
